Roman
Founder & Sole Principal

Roman built STORM ARCHITECTURE as a single-person answer to a multi-discipline problem — the belief that one sharp point of view, run with total consistency, beats a hundred disconnected specialists.

Every discipline under the STORM banner — cars, objects, packaging, beverage, fashion, tech, games — runs through the same five-stage pipeline and the same eye. AI is the studio's leverage: research, iteration, and visualization at a pace no traditional agency can match, with every final call made by hand.

The result is not a portfolio of unrelated projects. It's one creative operating system, applied wherever it's needed next.
